name: shadowlap-monorepo
description: Record, replay and fork AI agent runs.

scripts.build: node scripts/prune-dist.mjs && tsc -b && node scripts/build-cjs.mjs && node packages/dashboard/build-ui.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && node scripts/build-cjs.mjs && tsc -p packages/dashboard/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dashboard/browser/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck:js && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run --workspace packages/cli --workspace packages/sdk --workspace packages/adapters 2>&1 | grep -E "npm notice (name|version|package size|total files|filename)|Tarball Contents"
scripts.lint: node scripts/eslint-parts.mjs && node scripts/lint-caps.mjs && uvx ruff@0.17.0 check && uvx --from mypy==2.4.0 mypy --config-file packages/cli/guard/mypy.ini
